description: This file defines the SearchThrowableHandler class, which handles exceptions and errors during search operations in SuiteCRM, providing user-friendly messages and detailed debug information when in developer mode.

classes.name: SearchThrowableHandler
classes.description: Handles exceptions/errors during search, displays error messages, and provides detailed debug info in developer mode.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with a Throwable and a SearchQuery.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Displays error message; shows detailed stack trace if in developer mode.

methods.name: getFriendlyMessage
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly error message based on the exception type.

methods.name: printStackTrace
methods.description: Displays a detailed exception page with debug info.

methods.name: getSearchWrapperStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current status of SearchWrapper for debugging.

methods.name: printFriendlyMessage
methods.description: Outputs a simple error message on the page.
